resources.string: Search Wikidata’s public listings for %1$s. Only this number is sent. A directory entry can be out of date and does not verify who sent the message.
No browser is available to open the website.
Send %1$s to ShadyCall to check public US complaint records and community reports. Coverage outside the US is limited.
Copy %1$s and open Truecaller’s search page in your browser. Paste the number there to search. Truecaller may require sign-in.

Look up the numbering area for %1$s. Only the area code and exchange (the first six national digits) are sent to Local Calling Guide. The result describes the original assignment. A sender can be anywhere.
